title: Add reflection entries and the Mistakes & reflection letter section
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml mailbox; same for registry_contracts — both green, with the new section, drop, exclusion, and refusal cases present and passing.
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/mailbox.rs: (1) add KIND_REFLECTION ("reflection") to the entry kinds; a reflection entry uses `what` = what went wrong and a new optional field `better` = what would have been better, mirrored onto LetterItem and emitted in letter frontmatter (additive key; existing consumers unchanged). (2) compose_body gains section "Mistakes & reflection" (new SECTION_ constant, added to the section list) rendered between "Broken or unfinished" and "Needs your call": one bullet per reflection entry, `<what> — better: <better>` (the one connective, like the needs-you "blocks:"), section dropped when no reflection entries exist (D7 drop rule). Reflection entries are EXCLUDED from Done and from choose_subject — a mistake is not a thing the run did, and a letter must not be titled by its mistake. (3) New verb `bee mailbox reflect --wrong <text> --better <text> [--run <id>]` in the same try_native, appending the entry for the current run via append_entry/record_stop; refuse with a typed message when --wrong or --better is missing or empty (D3); default the run id the same way the existing stops do (run_id). (4) Add the command to src/generated/registry_payload.json (edit the JSON directly, mirroring the mailbox.mark entry's shape). (5) Inline tests in mailbox.rs mod tests: section renders with the connective and in the right position; a run with zero reflection entries files a letter without the section; reflection entries never appear in Done nor win the subject; the append refusal fires on a missing part; the existing authorship-walk test covers the new section (extend it if it enumerates sections). Do NOT touch mailbox_digest.rs — lesson mining sources stay unchanged (D4). Run the mailbox-scoped tests plus registry_contracts before capping.
